steps.text: Bring a shovel, a scythe, food and some health potions or fluids.
steps.source: Required Equipment: Shovel, Scythe, 2-4 Small Health Potions, Food. You need 102 oz.

steps.text: Go down into the bear cave east of Rookgaard.
steps.source: Go to the Bear Cave located east of Rookgaard (Mapper Coords 125.146, 125.208, 7). Now go down the hole.

steps.text: Take the southern way past the bears to the pool and dig the hole with your shovel.
steps.source: The cave splits in two ways: Choose the southern path. At the end, there's a pool of water and a hole, open it with your Shovel and go down.

steps.text: Cut the wheat with your scythe and run over the fire fields to the dead dragon.
steps.source: Now use your Scythe to cut the Wheat. Now you have to walk over 4 Large Fire Fields and 1 Medium Fire Field.

steps.text: In the dead dragon: a bag with a copper shield and a legion helmet. Run back over the fire straight away.
steps.source: Inside the dead dragon you will find a bag containing a Copper Shield and a Legion Helmet. Return quickly to the entrance.
